# qrcode-generator

Vendored, not loaded from a CDN. The tool that uses it draws a code people
print on flyers and stick on merch; a third party being down, or shipping
different bytes one day, is not an acceptable failure mode for that.

    package  qrcode-generator 2.0.4
    licence  MIT, Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase
    source   https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz
    sha512   mZSiP6RnbHl4xL2Ap5HfkjLnmxfKcPWpWe/c+5XxCuetEenqmNFf1FH/ftXPCtFG5/TDobjsjz6sSNL0Sr8Z9g==

The integrity hash above was checked against the one npm publishes for that
version before the file was copied in. No dependencies of its own.

Only dist/qrcode.js is kept. The package also ships SJIS and UTF-8 variants
and a test suite, none of which this site needs.
